استأنوا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْنَوْا (istaʔnaw) /is.taʔ.naw/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
# اِسْتَأْنُوا (istaʔnū) /is.taʔ.nuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْنَى (istaʔnā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
